tools.name: adopt
tools.description: Copy findings from a local bundle into the target PR bundle and re-anchor them. Call after a local review to post it on a PR. Writes the target bundle's findings store.

from.description: Local bundle slug to adopt findings from.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: calibrate
tools.description: Join stored findings against live thread and file state, or grade the offline probe. Call after posting to measure precision. Reads GitHub live; the probe rewrites kb-grades.jsonl.

judgeFile.description: Path to a judge spec file (probe mode).

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

probe.description: Grade the offline probe instead of joining live state.

tools.name: check-tree
tools.description: Gate on a clean git worktree, allowing the paths in expect. Call before finalizing when stray edits must fail the review. Reads git only; writes nothing.

expect.description: Comma-separated allowlist of paths that may be dirty.

tools.name: config
tools.description: Explain the stored effective policy of a fetched run, or preview a proposed configuration file with current settings and environment. Call before acting on policy to see values, requirements, plan, and spend. Reads the run bundle only; writes nothing and never approves.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Preflight the configured code host's CLI and auth, git, and storage. Call first when a verb fails for environmental reasons; provider picks the host (default github). Reads local tools and config; writes nothing.

provider.description: Code host to preflight (github, gitlab, gitcafe, forgejo, bitbucket, azure); default github.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a PR into .verdict/state/<pr> (diff, metadata, threads, prompt input). Call first for any PR review; an over-cap diff refuses, so re-run with chunk=true. Writes the bundle and calls the PR's host.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: fetch-local
tools.description: Fetch a local git diff into .verdict/state/local-<name>. Call to review uncommitted or branch changes without a PR. Writes the bundle; no network.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: fix
tools.description: Run one bounded, verify-gated fix pass over an inline finding. Call after review to prepare one finding's patch; the ledger caps passes. Writes the fix ledger and runs the recorded verify command.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: index
tools.description: Query the local Go index under .verdict/index for callers, candidate tests, co-change partners, CODEOWNERS owners, or stored trees. Call before editing code to find callers and the tests to read. Reads the index and git objects only; never builds or prunes (those are CLI-only) and writes nothing.

at.description: Tree or ref to query; default HEAD.

commits.description: Co-change window size in commits (1-100000; default 2000).

from.description: Checkout directory to read the index from; default the repository root.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return (1-200; default 50 for callers and tests-for, 20 for co-changed).

minCount.description: Minimum co-change count a partner needs (1-100000; default 2).

path.description: Repository path for tests-for, co-changed, or owners.

query.description: Subcommand to serve: callers, status, tests-for, co-changed, or owners. Build and prune stay on the CLI.

since.description: Co-change window start: a duration (90d, 12w, 18mo, 2y) or a commit ref.

symbol.description: Caller query symbol (bare Target or package-qualified app.Target), or the tests-for --symbol input.

tools.name: init
tools.description: Scaffold .verdict control files from a style preset. Call once in a new repository; yes=true overwrites existing controls. Writes controls and runs a tree check.

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Read or update the local knowledge base. Call to list rules or add, retire, or restore one. Writes .verdict/kb.jsonl.

status.description: List rules with counters and precision (boolean list switch; learn sets no status).

tools.name: next
tools.description: Return the top actionable finding. Call after fetch to pick the next review or fix target. Reads the bundle; writes nothing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

status.description: Status filter for the top finding (all, open, addressed, wont-fix, false-positive, deferred); empty means open.

tools.name: pack
tools.description: List the lens packs that apply here: built-in, org (personal settings packs[]), and repo (.verdict/packs/), in precedence order, with lens and rule ids and drift. Call before reviewing to see which pack steers the run. Reads local files; writes nothing.

tools.name: post
tools.description: Post exactly one review to GitHub, GitLab, or Forgejo, or preview with dryRun. Call once after review.json is final; never write a review note. A secret-shaped value refuses post-secret-shaped (allowSecretValues publishes it). Writes post.json; GitLab posts a bound request-changes as a comment, recorded in withheld[].

allowSecretValues.description: Publish review text that carries a secret-shaped value; the post-secret-shaped refusal names this override.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

force.description: Override the refusal that would otherwise block the change.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: ready
tools.description: Report merge readiness (checks, threads, draft, conflict) or gate on it. Call before merging. Reads GitHub; writes nothing.

check.description: Gate tier (critical, important, informational); empty disables the gate.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: record
tools.description: Validate review.json and merge it into the findings and record stores. Call for local bundles that cannot post; writes findings.json and record.json. Set dry_run to repeat every check without writing, fix each problem, and after 3 rounds report any that remain instead of recording.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: report
tools.description: Render the offline review report (ranked findings, counts, markdown/SARIF). Call after fetch or record; the follow-up is next. Reads the bundle and writes only artifacts you request.

category.description: Finding category filter; empty disables the filter.

check.description: Gate tier (critical, important, informational); empty disables the gate.

output.description: Write the rendered report markdown to this path.

sarif.description: Write a SARIF report to this path.

status.description: Status filter (all, open, addressed, wont-fix, false-positive, deferred).

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: show
tools.description: Return one full finding by signature or unique prefix. Call to inspect a finding named by report or next. Reads the bundle; writes nothing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: threads
tools.description: Refresh the normalized review-thread feed (.verdict/state/<pr>/threads.json) from the host, or with resolve close verdict-authored threads. Call after pushing fixes to re-read resolution state before a re-review or merge readiness. Reads the host; writes threads.json and, on resolve, threads-resolve.json.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

tools.name: trend
tools.description: Roll up review outcomes across fetched bundles. Call for a cross-PR summary. Reads local bundles; writes nothing.

tools.name: triage
tools.description: Operator-only: flip one finding's status with a rationale. Never call while reviewing a PR; propose triage[] in review.json instead. Writes findings.json and stages KB credit.

dryRun.description: Report what would change without writing.

force.description: Override the refusal that would otherwise block the change.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

status.description: Status to flip the finding to (open, addressed, wont-fix, false-positive, deferred).

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run the recorded verifyCmd under the watchdog and record the proof. Pass group and command together to validate one deep plan group at the reviewed root, or set sandbox true for enforced bubblewrap isolation on Linux (refused where unenforceable). Never fabricates a patch or a command from configuration.

command.description: Deep validation: explicit command to run at the reviewed root. Requires group.

group.description: Deep validation: stable plan group id from run.json. Requires command.

pr.description: Pull-request number or bundle slug (local-<name> for local bundles).

sandbox.description: Run under bwrap (Linux only) with no network, hidden credential dirs, a writable repo, and a private /tmp; refuses sandbox-unavailable when it cannot be enforced.
